dialog: Now it's time for the counterstroke.
I think this will bring an end to things.
You didn't really think you could escape/ did you?
Now it's my turn.
I'll show you what I can do.
Let's bring this to a swift end.
No matter who faces me the outcome will be the same.
I'll end this with the least of my attacks.
Well then/ I think you'd best prepare yourself.
You don't seem like you'll be appreciably difficult/ but...
I suppose you'll suffice as an opponent for now.
Checkmate in eight moves.
I've got to give my utmost- that's all there is to it!
I can't lose/ I have orders to the contrary!
You've put up quite the fight/ but this is it for you!
This situation is still accounted for in my calculations.
Too slow!
Got you!
You left yourself open!
If I just envision it/ I can go even faster.
I'll see to you with this.
I'll be watching how well you can deal with this.
Surge forth/ light!
I genuinely want to see how you could dodge this.
You're gathered in JUST the right arrangement now.
Coveting in moderation isn't really a sin.
Why don't I do away with all of you at once?
It's fruitless to try to flee.
A contract/ in exchange for its restrictions/ bestows great benefits...
And accepting a contract beyond your station brings ruin!
Why don't I show you the power of having nine tails?
And now/ the highlight!
In the Outside World/ I've heard they call on Kokkuri-san for fun...
How reckless of them indeed!
Chen/ come over here.
Good girl/ now do just as I say/ okay?
Yes/ Miss Ran!
Possession! Shikigami Chen!
With our simultaneous attacks/ we cannot miss!
Got it!
Synchronized!
Leaping!
Attack!
Youkai Domination!
Owie...
Hmm/ the shiki was a little weak...
Ready yourself/ Chen.
Just do exactly as we practiced.
I- I'll do my best!
Begin Pattern: CHEN!
Constantly Clashing Combination...
Engage!
One!
Two
Three!
This is your end!
M- Miss Ran/ I'm sooorry!
You're just so unreliable/ Chen...
Chen/ come here/ come here.
All you have to do is follow your orders to the letter.
I can do it/ I'm a Shikigami too!
Shikigami: CHEN... Activate!
Synchronization confirmed... Begin!
Sure/ here I go!
Attack!
Hit!
And one more!
Pattern Complete. Good job/ Chen!
M- Miss Ran/ I'm sooorry!
You're just so unreliable/ Chen...
I should take a moment to examine the situation.
I had to direct my full attention to evasion...
Losing track of my opponent... that's my own blunder.
There's no reason to fire if I don't have a chance of hitting.
How dare you!
I've come to help—Withdraw for now.
I leave the rest to you.
It'd be efficient to add a few more troubles to their plate.
It seems faster if I block this for you.
I'm under orders to protect my partners.
Providing my assistance. Please put the finishing touches on them.
I've taken into account your movements as well.
They're the target? A prudent decision.
It'd be best if you coordinate your attacks with me.
As instructed by my orders/ I will provide support.
Have you picked a target?
Very well/ I'll also contribute to this.
You can entrust this task to me.
It'd be efficient to add a few more troubles to their plate.
Even one hit should be enough.
Let's focus our offensive.
To spare no effort here is a prudent decision.
As instructed by Lady Yukari/ I am temporarily at your service.
Let's put the finishing touches on this/ shall we?
I'll kill you.
Alright/ Chen. I'll show you how it's done.
Oh/ Chen... That's not enough to actually defeat someone!
Trying to do something to Chen on my watch?!
You weren't even aware I was here/ you absolute fool.
Chen/ are you getting sleepy?
Chen is just so unreliable...
No/ no/ Chen/ if you move like that they'll...
You think I'll let you bother my Chen?!
I'll leave the last part to you/ Chen/ alright?
Alright/ Chen/ follow my lead.
I'll clear a path for you/ Chen.
Chen/ I'm here to help you.
Chen/ I'll show you how to do it.
Chen/ let's show them our full power.
Chen/ you're in fine spirits today.
Chen/ I'll stay by you and show you what to do.
Don't think I'll let you get out of this alive!
I'll vanquish any who stand in Lady Yukari's way!
As you wish/ Lady Yukari.
I will bring victory to Lady Yukari.
Lady Yukari/ please leave the remainder to me.
To try to wound Lady Yukari...
If that's the best that you can do/ you won't be able to touch Lady Yukari.
I have confirmed the target.
Someone like you isn't even worth troubling Lady Yukari over!
Over here/ Lady Yukari?
As Lady Yukari instructs.
You don't merit Lady Yukari's attention.
Lady Yukari/ let us put an end to this right here.
Lady Yukari/ let's finish them off.
I will devote my all to fulfilling Lady Yukari's orders!
How dare you harm Youmu!
Youmu/ I can provide assistance!
I need to factor Youmu's movements into my calculations...
Allow me to handle this one/ Youmu.
I'll take this one/ Youmu.
Youmu/ I'll give you some help.
Youmu/ I leave the finishing strike to you!
Youmu/ let's focus our attacks!
Youmu's sword will decide this!
I'm commencing my attack/ Youmu!
Youmu/ let's finish them off!
I will do my utmost as Lady Yukari wishes.
Youmu/ let's show them our full strength!
This is quite the trouble. \n What ever will I say to Lady Yukari?
Lady Yuyuko/ leave the rest up to me.
Lady Yuyuko/ I'll provide assistance.
Please be careful/ Lady Yuyuko.
I'm not happy with you trying to strike Lady Yuyuko.
I'll be taking the first move/ please help with the follow-up.
My orders include providing support for Lady Yuyuko.
Lady Yuyuko/ I'm here to aid you.
Lady Yuyuko/ please don't get too far ahead of me.
I'll show you how I can predict Lady Yuyuko's actions!
Lady Yuyuko/ I'll give it my all!
Lady Yuyuko/ let's finish them off!
Lady Yuyuko/ I will do my utmost/ as Lady Yukari wishes.
This is quite the trouble. \n What ever will I say to Lady Yukari?
Perhaps you can grasp even my movement patterns/ Reimu?
Don't let your guard down/ Reimu.
I had hoped you'd be able to dodge that/ given that you're the Hakurei Shrine Maiden.
Get it together. Is THIS what counts as enough to be the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary?
I'll provide you with support/ just as Lady Yukari ordered.
How dare you harm Shou!
Finishing them off like this―Is this a predator's instinct?
Your movements aren't bad. I'll provide follow-up.
You're trying your best/ so I'll help out.
It'd be regrettable if you fell here.
Let's try attacking simultaneously.
Are you able to match my movements/ Shou?
Shou/ I want to see what you can do.
Are you keeping up/ Shou?!
Shou/ let me see what you can do!
Shou/ let's fight like our instincts call for!
A splendid decision/ Shou.
Shou/ as Lady Yukari requests I am at your service.
What a sub-par attack.
Your movements aren't worth bothering to analyze.
Now run along and make yourself scarce.
I don't need to dodge such an unsophisticated attack.
You think I'll let you keep going unchallenged like this?!
I won't let myself be disgraced in Lady Yukari's presence!
Agh/ if I don't change my evasion pattern soon...
That was a step above what I expected. I'll have to revise my evaluation of you.
I didn't expect this...
I wasn't expecting to fight someone on my own level.
Ugh/ to let myself get hit like that...
I can't believe I misread it like that!
I took a direct hit...
You hit me square on... good aim.
Ugh/ that was a good move...
I'll keep my losses to a minimum!
I'll just block this one now.
I'll show you how I defeat attacks like this.
You must know that I won't concede to attacks of this caliber.
This won't be an impediment to further combat.
As long as I stay vigilant/ you can't hit me.
Your patterns are completely transparent.
It's only a matter of calculating my opponents' movements.
You'll find yourself in quite the bind if you continue such wasteful actions.
Stay unflustered and they can't possibly beat you.
I expect this tactic to prove efficient.
Employing a minimal evasive movement strategy/ for now.
It's fine to be able to perfectly evade an attack/ but...
It's impossible for you to catch me like that.
A rather wastefully inefficient attack.
I think it best if you pick a different opponent.
You can't keep fighting in such a clumsy manner.
Can you keep up with my speed?!
A trivial attack.
That just won't get through.
Tail Sword!
I knew that it would come to this moment.
It's foolhardy to let your guard down in front of me.
Yes/ exactly where I calculated you would go.
I can't believe this was the end result...
To fall here... how mortifying...
I had no intention of taking an easy way out/ but I suppose I must admit my defeat.
Ignominious though it may be/ I find I must pull back now.
For the sake of Gensokyo/ I will deal with you quickly.
I'm worried about Utsuho's safety...\n but I can't let that make me hold back.
Giving us advanced notice of an incident... Hmph/ what arrogant behavior.
There's already enough troubles to go around!
It seems like just don't learn.\n I'll just have to catch you.
You can't hide any longer!
You can't hide any longer!
Who knew you'd case all this?
Are you truly going to fight all of us in this state?
I already know the ways you attack by heart.
To steal Lady Yukari's shape? How appalling...
I'll show you how to dispel your illusions!
We'll soon have no further business with you.
If you get in our way/\n you'll be shown what a real nightmare is.
You have no right to use this power.\n You're not even a shiki.
... This is my duty. I won't show you any lenience.
Muwatari Makura/ \n I'll be taking back Gensokyo's dreams now.
This is the last battle/ I imagine.\n I'll give it everything I have!
As Lady Yukari so orders/\n I will oppose you with everything I have!
